tables.name: Halingo Naming Method
tables.description: Which naming method a Halingo settlement name uses. Each result is a naming method; its faces are its weight (starter weights 70% / 30%). Arid frontier style: dry, understated and slightly harsh.

results.name: Geographic Compound
results.description: First element + second element as two words, e.g. Khar Well, Cinder Ridge.

results.name: Historical Founder
results.description: Founder's name + a settlement feature, e.g. Varesh's Well. A founder ending in s takes an apostrophe only.
